note: One unit a casting names as hit, and how it was hit.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the hit is, along one ground axis, in world units. A client gives it to the missile it makes for this hit.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the hit is, in height, in world units. A client gives it to the missile it makes for this hit.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the hit is, along the other ground axis, in world units. A client gives it to the missile it makes for this hit.
